request.text: I need a new Windows laptop for spreadsheets with a built-in numeric keypad, at least 16 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD. Deliver to Byblos.

message:
Best provisional option: Abed Tahan’s Lenovo V15, Core i5-13420H, 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD — $695.00, listed in stock with Windows 11 Pro.
The specifications suit spreadsheet work, but the shop page does not explicitly confirm new condition or the built-in numeric keypad.
Abed Tahan advertises delivery across Lebanon, covering Byblos in principle; the delivery fee is not published in the checked information.
My suggestion: shortlist this Lenovo, but confirm that it is brand-new, has the numeric keypad, and the delivery charge before ordering. I could not fully verify a match to every requirement.
